ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; approximately 75% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels to 25% high-intensity (white/cream) pixels concentrated on the lateral lobe surfaces.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large, contiguous high-intensity (white) regions on the outer distal portions of both lobes. The right lobe contains a dominant, vertically-oriented white band with internal low-intensity speckling. The left lobe exhibits a wedge-shaped high-intensity region along the anterior margin. Central peduncle attachment region is uniformly low-intensity.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression; calculated interior angle of approximately 55 degrees with a well-defined vertex at the midline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular topography; high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) across the entire visible span, with increased amplitude and frequency on the distal portions of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex sweep on the leading edges transitioning to a concave-upward curvature toward the distal tips along the trailing edge.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density spatial clusters of localized, roughly circular high-intensity pixel aggregates concentrated on the distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of three distinct, vertically-aligned, low-intensity linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the high-intensity patch on the right lobe, oriented perpendicular to the trailing edge boundary.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent surface irregularities on the distal tips corresponding to high-intensity massing; distinct irregular indentation/notch on the trailing edge of the right lobe distal to the median notch.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique internal high-intensity speckling pattern isolated within the primary high-contrast patch of the right lobe.
